$comment: Engines and their models: background removal, the PiD backbone, and the spandrel loader floor.
Everything here used to be a compile-time constant, so a new matting model or a new PiD
checkpoint required an app release. Overriding an entry from %APPDATA%/Filesmith/registry/user
works exactly as it does for generation models.
IMPORTANT — the removebg list is a LICENCE boundary, not a menu. rembg exposes 19 sessions and
gives no per-model licence warning, so shipping its catalogue wholesale would quietly
redistribute non-commercial weights. Verified against primary sources: bria-rmbg resolves to
RMBG-2.0 (CC BY-NC 4.0); u2net_human_seg is trained on Supervisely Person (non-commercial);
isnet-anime has scraped fandom provenance; sam produces prompt-driven binary masks and is the
wrong tool for a cutout. Those stay out. What changed is WHERE the vetted list lives, not

entries.label: PiD (Flux distilled, 4-step)
$comment: repoRef pins the nv-tlabs/PiD source. It used to be archive/refs/heads/main.zip — the head
of a MOVING branch — recorded in an EMPTY marker file, so two users installing a month
apart ran different code with no way to tell which, and neither could ever receive a fix.
The ref is now written into the marker and a mismatch forces a re-vendor.

entries.label: spandrel model loader
$comment: The version floor for the ComfyUI-upscaler loader. install.ts recorded an EMPTY marker, so
whatever spandrel resolved on the day the user set up was frozen forever: a model with a
newer architecture then reported 'could not be read' with no UI anywhere to update the
loader. The installed version is now written into the marker and compared against this.
